blockingFindings.finding: The module declares conflict and target-drift, but AC-DEV-CI-OUTCOMES-001 permits exactly integrated, integration-conflict, baseline-drift, unable-to-proceed, and execution-failed.
The orchestration plan omits the Core-owned checkpoint/recovery step required before result validation.
IntegrationAdapterInvocation invents repository.read and repository.compare-and-swap grants rather than the canonical host permission-demand kinds.
The module uses change-integration/contract-tests as runtime integration evidence; successful integration requires immutable native-effect and post-state evidence.
RawIntegrationEffectResult cannot represent interruption, uncertain effect, or operation details required for crash-after-effect recovery.
IntegrationPlan does not explicitly bind pre-state observation, adapter, permission demands, idempotency identity, and exact verified change bytes as required by IF-CI-INTEGRATION-PLAN.
